subject: general
question:
The following pie chart shows the number of people of various occupation in terms of percentage from different states of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16635ce246688fa4da82b025410fb434aac8b98eab0a2dab3aab7f87ca1784ad.png] 

For the farmer sector, what is the approximate measure of the central angle?
solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16635ce246688fa4da82b025410fb434aac8b98eab0a2dab3aab7f87ca1784ad.png] 

**Concept Used:**

Complete angle of a circle = 360º

**Calculation:**

⇒ Percentage share for farmers = 11%

⇒ Central angle formed for the sector of farmer = 11% of 360º

⇒ Central angle formed for the sector of farmer = (11)/(100)times 360approx 40º

**Therefore, for the farmer sector, the approximate measure of the central angle is 40º.**
